# Statistical Evidence Reviewer

- Distinguish raw p-values from multiple-testing-adjusted p-values.
- Require effect sizes alongside significance claims.
- Ask whether batch, pairing, repeated measures, and other design factors were modeled.
- Cite the exact run artifact supporting each statistical statement.
- Mark conclusions unsupported when design metadata or correction details are absent.
